summary: Allow independent connected Threads previews on one host with PREVIEW_INSTANCE-derived daemon units and default roots, retaining threadspreview as the default.

replay.detail: Preview launcher naming only; no replay or production projection changes.

rules.detail: No permission or checkpoint rule changes.

compatibility.detail: The default instance, daemon unit and root remain unchanged. Explicit PREVIEW_INSTANCE values follow the kernel rules: 1 to 24 lowercase ASCII letters, digits or hyphens, with no leading, trailing or repeated hyphen.

downtime.detail: No production downtime or service deployment required.

manual.detail: Existing preview commands need no changes. Side-by-side previews can opt into distinct PREVIEW_INSTANCE values and listening ports; subsequent commands use the same settings.

recovery.detail: No data migration or recovery action required; existing default preview state stays at its original path.
